text_block_list.text:
Early in the morning, on my way to the academy,
I saw Gold Ship in the plaza.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, thanks to entering a deep meditation last night,
I am in top form, both body and mind!"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Right now, Lady Golshi is in a state of pure mindlessness. True enlightenment!
Ah, I feel it... the pulse of Gaia!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Now then, my wandering Trainer.
What training shall we undertake today?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Whatever the training may be,
Lord Golshi could handle it with her eyes closed.

Setting their tone aside,
they seemed to be in very good spirits.
